sources.fact: LBBD67/DJ Clockhouse Avenue is 0.74ha, deliverable and carries 250 minimum/maximum net dwelling capacity.
Brownfield notes explicitly state Part permissioned for 59 homes.
Record gives full-planning-permission date 28 October 2022 while retaining whole-site capacity at 250.
Planning history points to Be First application id 28966; this wave does not guess additional whole-site case references.
DJ has a point and blank geometry; point is not site-allocation/red-line/title polygon.
Ownership-status owned-by-a-public-authority is a category, not a legal proprietor/title number.
Regulation 19 Local Plan decision materials include a separate DJ Clockhouse Avenue allocation document, establishing allocation provenance rather than whole-site permission.
Regulation 19 agenda separately lists DJ Clockhouse Avenue among allocation documents.
Nearby Barking Town Centre applications are not transferred to DJ without exact case/address binding.
Current case status must be verified against exact planning application/decision records.
Adopted Local Plan allocation capacity is policy evidence, not itself planning permission.
Brownfield capacity/status is kept separate from HMLR legal title and executed overlay evidence.

examples.result: DJ whole-site capacity remains 250 net dwellings.
Only 59 homes are explicitly identified as part-permissioned in the current Brownfield note.
59 is not extrapolated to permission for all 250 homes.
250 is not treated as consented-unit count.
Public-authority ownership category is not converted to a named owner/title.
Point/blank geometry is not converted into a site polygon.
Nearby town-centre permissions are not transferred to DJ.
Promotion remains zero until exact whole-site/title relation and executed overlays are verified.
